title: Paid run estimates come out well below the real cost
what: Estimates for paid runs come out well below the real cost; they should come from the ledger's measured costs.
why: Low estimates mean the daily cap is raised by hand over and over; the owner cannot plan spend.
failing_case: estimates were low: Sonnet measure $3.02 estimated, $6.32 spent; live6 $1.90 estimated, $3.37 spent; four cap raises on 22 Oct; the judge-measure README's Sonnet figures come from two runs; should come from the ledger's measured costs (handover "cost estimates from real numbers", "Sonnet measurement figures come from two runs")
